subject: english
label: 高校英作文（構文）
blurb: 仮定法・関係詞・分詞構文・倒置。高校の基本構文を日本語から英文にして打つ
audience: 高校生、大学入試の英作文に備える人

words.answer: It has been raining since this morning.
accept: It's been raining since this morning.
words.q: 今朝からずっと雨が降っています。
words.explain: 「ずっと〜し続けている」は have been -ing。起点は since。It is raining since は誤り
words.say: It has been raining since this morning.

words.answer: I have been waiting for two hours.
accept: I've been waiting for two hours.
words.q: 私は2時間ずっと待っています。
words.explain: 今も続く動作は現在完了進行形。期間は for。I am waiting for two hours は誤り
words.say: I have been waiting for two hours.

words.answer: How long have you been studying English?
words.ja: 現在完了進行形の疑問文
words.q: あなたはどのくらい英語を勉強し続けているのですか。（現在完了進行形で）
words.explain: How long＋have＋主語＋been -ing。Since when より How long が普通。studying の綴り注意
words.say: How long have you been studying English?

words.answer: The train had already left when I arrived.
accept: The train had already left when I got there.
When I arrived, the train had already left.
words.q: 私が着いたとき、電車はもう出発していました。
words.explain: 「着いた」より前に完了→過去完了 had left。already は had と過去分詞の間
words.say: The train had already left when I arrived.

words.answer: She lost the watch her father had given her.
accept: She lost the watch that her father had given her.
She lost the watch which her father had given her.
words.q: 彼女は父がくれた時計をなくしました。（過去完了を使って）
words.explain: 「くれた」はなくした時点より前→had given。give 人 物 の「人」her を落とさない
words.say: She lost the watch her father had given her.

words.answer: I will have finished the work by tomorrow.
accept: I'll have finished the work by tomorrow.
I will have finished the job by tomorrow.
words.q: 明日までにはその仕事を終えているでしょう。
words.explain: 未来のある時点までに完了→will have done。「〜までには」は by、until は「〜までずっと」
words.say: I will have finished the work by tomorrow.

words.answer: If I visit Kyoto again, I will have been there three times.
accept: If I visit Kyoto again, I'll have been there three times.
words.q: もう一度京都に行けば、3回行ったことになります。
words.explain: 未来の時点での経験は will have been。if 節は現在形 visit。「行ったことになる」に will go は不可
words.say: If I visit Kyoto again, I will have been there three times.

words.answer: Next year we will have been married for ten years.
accept: Next year we'll have been married for ten years.
We will have been married for ten years next year.
words.q: 来年で私たちは結婚して10年になります。
words.explain: 未来の時点までの継続は will have been＋状態。be married は状態。marry を進行形にしない
words.say: Next year we will have been married for ten years.

words.answer: You should have listened to your teacher.
accept: You should've listened to your teacher.
words.q: あなたは先生の言うことを聞くべきだったのに。
words.explain: should have done＝「すべきだったのに（しなかった）」。listen to の to を落とさない
words.say: You should have listened to your teacher.

words.answer: He must have been very tired.
accept: He must've been very tired.
words.q: 彼はとても疲れていたにちがいない。
words.explain: 過去の確信ある推量は must have done。must be は現在の推量。had to be にしない
words.say: He must have been very tired.

words.answer: She may have missed the train.
accept: She might have missed the train.
She may've missed the train.
words.q: 彼女は電車に乗り遅れたのかもしれない。
words.explain: 「〜したかもしれない」は may/might have done。「乗り遅れる」は miss。lose にしない
words.say: She may have missed the train.

words.answer: He cannot have said such a thing.
accept: He can't have said such a thing.
He couldn't have said such a thing.
words.q: 彼がそんなことを言ったはずがない。
words.explain: 「〜したはずがない」は cannot have done。must have done の反対。such a thing の語順
words.say: He cannot have said such a thing.

words.answer: You need not have hurried.
accept: You needn't have hurried.
words.q: あなたは急ぐ必要はなかったのに。（need を使って）
words.explain: need not have done＝「する必要がなかったのに（した）」。didn't need to は「しなかった」含み
words.say: You need not have hurried.

words.answer: If I were rich, I would buy a big house.
accept: If I were rich, I'd buy a big house.
If I was rich, I would buy a big house.
words.q: もし私が金持ちなら、大きな家を買うのに。
words.explain: 現在の事実に反する仮定は if＋過去形、主節は would＋原形。be は were が基本
words.say: If I were rich, I would buy a big house.

words.answer: If I knew her number, I could call her.
accept: If I knew her phone number, I could call her.
words.q: 彼女の番号を知っていれば、電話できるのに。
words.explain: 「できるのに」は could＋原形。If I know にしない。call は他動詞なので call to her は誤り
words.say: If I knew her number, I could call her.

words.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
accept: If I'd studied harder, I would've passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the test.
words.q: もっと一生懸命勉強していたら、試験に合格していただろうに。
words.explain: 過去の事実に反する仮定は if＋had done、主節は would have done。「合格する」は pass
words.say: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

words.answer: I wish I were taller.
accept: I wish I was taller.
words.q: 私がもっと背が高ければいいのになあ。
words.explain: 現在の願望は I wish＋過去形。I wish I am は誤り。hope は実現可能なことに使う
words.say: I wish I were taller.

words.answer: I wish I had gone to the party.
accept: I wish I'd gone to the party.
words.q: 私はそのパーティーに行けばよかったなあ。
words.explain: 過去の後悔は I wish＋had done。「行けばよかった」を I wish I went にしない
words.say: I wish I had gone to the party.

words.answer: He talks as if he knew everything.
accept: He talks as though he knew everything.
words.q: 彼は何でも知っているかのように話す。
words.explain: 「実際は違うのに〜かのように」は as if＋過去形。主節が現在でも knew。knows は事実に近い含み
words.say: He talks as if he knew everything.

words.answer: Without water, nothing could live.
accept: Without water, nothing would be able to live.
But for water, nothing could live.
words.q: 水がなければ、何も生きられないだろう。（live を使って）
words.explain: Without ＝ If it were not for。主節は仮定法なので could。nothing は単数扱い
words.say: Without water, nothing could live.

words.answer: Without your help, I could not have finished it.
accept: Without your help, I couldn't have finished it.
But for your help, I could not have finished it.
words.q: あなたの助けがなければ、私はそれを終えられなかっただろう。
words.explain: 過去のことなら主節は could not have done。Without＝If it had not been for。it を忘れない
words.say: Without your help, I could not have finished it.

words.answer: It is time you went to bed.
accept: It's time you went to bed.
It is about time you went to bed.
words.q: もう寝てもいい頃ですよ。（It is time＋仮定法で）
words.explain: It is time＋主語＋過去形＝「もう〜してもいい頃」。go にしない。for you to go は別の型
words.say: It is time you went to bed.

words.answer: If it were not for music, life would be boring.
accept: If it weren't for music, life would be boring.
If it were not for music, life would be dull.
words.q: 音楽がなければ、人生は退屈だろう。（If it were not for を使って）
words.explain: 「〜がなければ」の定型。it と for を落とさない。「退屈な」は boring（bored は人が主語）
words.say: If it were not for music, life would be boring.

words.answer: I have a friend whose father is a doctor.
words.q: 私には父親が医者である友達がいます。
words.explain: 所有を表す関係代名詞 whose＋名詞。whose father の直後に動詞。who's と混同しない
words.say: I have a friend whose father is a doctor.

words.answer: I could not understand what he said.
accept: I couldn't understand what he said.
words.q: 私は彼の言ったことが理解できませんでした。
words.explain: what＝the thing(s) which。先行詞を含むので the thing what や that は誤り
words.say: I could not understand what he said.

words.answer: This is the town where I was born.
accept: This is the town in which I was born.
words.q: ここは私が生まれた町なのです。
words.explain: 場所＋where＋完全な文。where＝in which。which I was born は前置詞がないので誤り
words.say: This is the town where I was born.

words.answer: I have a brother, who lives in Osaka.
accept: I have an older brother, who lives in Osaka.
I have one brother, who lives in Osaka.
words.q: 私には兄が一人いて、大阪に住んでいます。
words.explain: カンマつき非制限用法＝兄は一人で補足説明。カンマなしだと「大阪に住む兄」（他にも兄がいる）
words.say: I have a brother, who lives in Osaka.

words.answer: He said nothing, which made her angry.
words.ja: 非制限用法 , which（文を受ける）
words.q: 彼は何も言わず、そのことが彼女を怒らせた。
words.explain: 前の文全体を受けるのは , which。that は不可。made her angry は make＋O＋C
words.say: He said nothing, which made her angry.

words.answer: Tell me the reason why you were late.
accept: Tell me why you were late.
Tell me the reason you were late.
words.q: あなたが遅れた理由を私に教えてください。
words.explain: the reason why＋完全な文。reason か why のどちらかは省略できる。「遅れた」は were late
words.say: Tell me the reason why you were late.

words.answer: The girl with whom I was talking is Emi.
accept: The girl whom I was talking with is Emi.
The girl who I was talking with is Emi.
words.q: 私が話していた女の子はエミです。（whom を使って）
words.explain: 前置詞を前に出すと with whom。with who は不可。主語 The girl と動詞 is が離れる点に注意
words.say: The girl with whom I was talking is Emi.

words.answer: Ken, whose mother is a teacher, is good at math.
words.q: ケンは母親が教師で、数学が得意です。（whose を使って）
words.explain: 固有名詞に続く関係詞は必ずカンマつき。挿入部を閉じるカンマを忘れない。be good at
words.say: Ken, whose mother is a teacher, is good at math.
accept: Ken, whose mother is a teacher, is good at mathematics.

words.answer: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
accept: Walking down the street, I met an old friend.
words.q: 通りを歩いていると、私は旧友に会いました。（分詞構文で）
words.explain: While I was walking → Walking。主語 I は主節と同じなので省く。an old friend の冠詞
words.say: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.

words.answer: Feeling tired, I went to bed early.
accept: Being tired, I went to bed early.
words.q: 疲れていたので、私は早く寝ました。（分詞構文で）
words.explain: Because I felt tired → Feeling tired。「寝る」は go to bed（sleep は眠る）
words.say: Feeling tired, I went to bed early.

words.answer: Not knowing what to do, she asked her teacher.
words.q: 何をすべきかわからなかったので、彼女は先生に尋ねた。（分詞構文で）
words.explain: 否定は分詞の直前に Not。Knowing not は誤り。what to do＝何をすべきか
words.say: Not knowing what to do, she asked her teacher.

words.answer: Written in plain English, this book is easy to read.
accept: Written in easy English, this book is easy to read.
Written in simple English, this book is easy to read.
words.q: やさしい英語で書かれているので、この本は読みやすい。（分詞構文で）
words.explain: 受動なら Being written の Being を省いて過去分詞で始める。Writing にすると本が書く意味
words.say: Written in plain English, this book is easy to read.

words.answer: Having finished my homework, I watched TV.
words.q: 宿題を終えてから、私はテレビを見た。（完了形の分詞構文で）
words.explain: 主節より前に終わったことは Having done。Finishing だと同時に見える。watch TV に the は不要
words.say: Having finished my homework, I watched TV.
accept: Having done my homework, I watched TV.

words.answer: Weather permitting, we will go on a picnic.
accept: Weather permitting, we'll go on a picnic.
words.q: 天気がよければ、私たちはピクニックに行きます。（Weather で始めて）
words.explain: 主語が主節と違うときは分詞の前に置く（独立分詞構文）。Weather permitting は決まり文句
words.say: Weather permitting, we will go on a picnic.

words.answer: I remember locking the door.
words.q: 私はドアにかぎをかけたことを覚えています。
words.explain: remember doing＝したことを覚えている。remember to do＝忘れずにする。過去のことでも locking
words.say: I remember locking the door.

words.answer: Remember to call me tonight.
accept: Please remember to call me tonight.
words.q: 今夜、忘れずに私に電話してね。（remember を使って）
words.explain: これからすることは remember to do。calling にすると「電話したことを覚えている」
words.say: Remember to call me tonight.

words.answer: My father stopped smoking last year.
words.q: 父は去年たばこをやめました。（stop を使って）
words.explain: stop doing＝やめる。stop to do＝〜するために立ち止まる。「たばこを吸う」は smoke 一語
words.say: My father stopped smoking last year.

words.answer: He stopped to talk with his friend.
accept: He stopped to talk to his friend.
words.q: 彼は友達と話すために立ち止まった。
words.explain: stop to do の to は目的（〜するために）。stopped talking だと「話すのをやめた」
words.say: He stopped to talk with his friend.

words.answer: I tried to open the window, but I couldn't.
accept: I tried to open the window, but I could not.
I tried to open the window, but couldn't.
words.q: 窓を開けようとしたが、できなかった。
words.explain: try to do＝しようと努力する（できたかは別）。try doing＝試しにやってみる。but の後の I を省かない
words.say: I tried to open the window, but I couldn't.

words.answer: I regret to say that I cannot help you.
accept: I regret to say that I can't help you.
I regret to say I cannot help you.
words.q: 残念ながらあなたを手伝うことができません。（regret を使って）
words.explain: regret to say＝残念ながら申し上げる。regret saying は「言ったことを後悔する」
words.say: I regret to say that I cannot help you.

words.answer: He made me wait for an hour.
words.q: 彼は私を1時間も待たせました。
words.explain: make＋人＋原形。made me to wait は誤り。an hour の冠詞は an（h が無音）
words.say: He made me wait for an hour.

words.answer: Let me know if you can come.
accept: Please let me know if you can come.
Let me know whether you can come.
words.q: 来られるかどうか教えてください。（let を使って）
words.explain: let＋人＋原形＝「〜させてあげる」。let me know は「知らせて」の定番。to know は誤り
words.say: Let me know if you can come.

words.answer: I saw him cross the street.
accept: I saw him cross the road.
words.q: 私は彼が通りを渡るのを見ました。
words.explain: see＋人＋原形＝渡り終えるまで一部始終を見た。crossing なら途中を見た。to cross は誤り
words.say: I saw him cross the street.

words.answer: I had my hair cut yesterday.
accept: I got my hair cut yesterday.
words.q: 私は昨日髪を切ってもらいました。
words.explain: have＋物＋過去分詞＝「〜してもらう」。I cut my hair は自分で切った意味。cut は過去分詞も cut
words.say: I had my hair cut yesterday.

words.answer: I had him carry my bag.
words.q: 私は彼に私のかばんを運んでもらった。（have を使って）
words.explain: have＋人＋原形＝「（当然のこととして）〜してもらう」。made だと強制、got なら to carry
words.say: I had him carry my bag.

words.answer: I heard someone singing in the next room.
accept: I heard somebody singing in the next room.
words.q: 隣の部屋で誰かが歌っているのが聞こえた。
words.explain: 「〜しているのが聞こえた」は hear＋O＋-ing（途中を知覚）。原形 sing なら最初から最後まで
words.say: I heard someone singing in the next room.

words.answer: She got her son to clean his room.
words.q: 彼女は息子に部屋を掃除させた。（get を使って）
words.explain: get だけは to 不定詞（説得して〜させる）。got her son clean は誤り。his room の所有格
words.say: She got her son to clean his room.

words.answer: The more you practice, the better you will become.
accept: The more you practice, the better you'll become.
The more you practice, the better you will get.
The more you practice, the better you'll get.
words.ja: the 比較級, the 比較級
words.q: 練習すればするほど、あなたはうまくなるでしょう。
words.explain: The＋比較級＋S V, the＋比較級＋S V。比較級を文頭に出す。The more you practice more は誤り
words.say: The more you practice, the better you will become.

words.answer: This bridge is twice as long as that one.
accept: This bridge is twice as long as that bridge.
words.q: この橋はあの橋の2倍の長さです。
words.explain: 倍数は as の前に置く（twice as long as）。as twice long は誤り。繰り返しは that one
words.say: This bridge is twice as long as that one.

words.answer: Please come as soon as possible.
accept: Please come as soon as you can.
Come as soon as possible, please.
words.q: できるだけ早く来てくださいね。
words.explain: 「できるだけ〜」は as＋原級＋as possible／as you can。as fast as は速度なので不可
words.say: Please come as soon as possible.

words.answer: The higher we climbed, the colder it became.
accept: The higher we climbed, the colder it got.
words.q: 高く登れば登るほど、寒くなった。
words.explain: 後半は天候の it を主語に。the colder it became の語順。became colder と戻さない
words.say: The higher we climbed, the colder it became.

words.answer: He has no more than ten dollars.
words.q: 彼はたった10ドルしか持っていない。（no more than を使って）
words.explain: no more than＝only（少ない）。not more than＝at most（多くても）。数字は英単語で
words.say: He has no more than ten dollars.

words.answer: No other mountain in Japan is as high as Mt. Fuji.
accept: No other mountain in Japan is higher than Mt. Fuji.
words.q: 日本の他のどの山も富士山ほど高くない。（No other で始めて）
words.explain: No other＋単数名詞＋is as 原級 as＝最上級の意味。mountains と複数にしない
words.say: No other mountain in Japan is as high as Mt. Fuji.

words.answer: He is the taller of the two.
accept: He's the taller of the two.
words.ja: the 比較級 of the two
words.q: 彼は2人のうちで背が高いほうです。
words.explain: 2人のうちの「〜なほう」は the＋比較級＋of the two。最上級 tallest は3人以上
words.say: He is the taller of the two.

words.answer: He is not so much a teacher as a scholar.
accept: He's not so much a teacher as a scholar.
He is not a teacher so much as a scholar.
words.ja: not so much A as B
words.q: 彼は教師というよりむしろ学者だ。（not so much を使って）
words.explain: not so much A as B＝AというよりむしろB。順序を逆にしない。B rather than A と同意
words.say: He is not so much a teacher as a scholar.

words.answer: It was Ken that broke the window.
accept: It was Ken who broke the window.
words.q: 窓を割ったのはケンでした。（強調構文で）
words.explain: It is/was＋強調する語＋that。人なら who も可。時制は元の文に合わせ was
words.say: It was Ken that broke the window.

words.answer: It was yesterday that I met her.
accept: It was yesterday when I met her.
words.q: 私が彼女に会ったのは昨日でした。（強調構文で）
words.explain: 副詞も It was … that で強調できる。that 以下は語順そのまま（I met her）
words.say: It was yesterday that I met her.

words.answer: Never have I seen such a beautiful sight.
accept: Never have I seen such a beautiful view.
Never have I seen such a beautiful scene.
words.q: そんなに美しい光景は見たことがない。（Never で始めて）
words.explain: 否定語が文頭に出ると疑問文の語順（Never have I seen）。Never I have seen は誤り
words.say: Never have I seen such a beautiful sight.

words.answer: I do hope you will come.
accept: I do hope you'll come.
I do hope that you will come.
words.q: あなたが来てくれることを本当に願っています。（do を使って）
words.explain: 動詞の強調は do／does／did＋原形。I do hope＝本当に願う。really hope とほぼ同じ
words.say: I do hope you will come.

words.answer: Little did I dream that I would win.
accept: Little did I dream I would win.
words.q: 自分が勝つとは夢にも思わなかった。（Little で始めて）
words.explain: Little（少しも〜ない）も否定語なので倒置。一般動詞なら did＋主語＋原形。時制の一致で would
words.say: Little did I dream that I would win.

words.answer: Not until yesterday did I know the truth.
accept: Not until yesterday did I learn the truth.
words.q: 昨日になって初めて私は真実を知った。（Not until で始めて）
words.explain: Not until＋時＋倒置（did I know）。「〜して初めて」。It was not until … that の言い換え
words.say: Not until yesterday did I know the truth.

words.answer: The news made me happy.
accept: The news made me glad.
words.q: その知らせを聞いて私はうれしくなった。（The news を主語に）
words.explain: 「〜を聞いて…になった」は物を主語に make＋人＋形容詞。news は単数扱い、複数形にしない
words.say: The news made me happy.

words.answer: This road will take you to the station.
accept: This road takes you to the station.
This road will lead you to the station.
words.q: この道を行けば駅に着きます。（This road を主語に）
words.explain: 「〜を行けば…に着く」は道を主語に take／lead＋人＋to 場所。arrive は使わない
words.say: This road will take you to the station.

words.answer: The heavy rain prevented us from going out.
words.q: 大雨のせいで私たちは外出できなかった。（prevent を使って）
words.explain: 「〜のせいで…できなかった」は原因を主語に prevent＋人＋from -ing。to go out は誤り
words.say: The heavy rain prevented us from going out.

words.answer: This picture reminds me of my childhood.
accept: This photo reminds me of my childhood.
words.q: この写真を見ると子どものころを思い出す。（remind を使って）
words.explain: 「〜を見ると…を思い出す」は remind＋人＋of。I remember でも言えるが物を主語にする型
words.say: This picture reminds me of my childhood.

words.answer: What brought you to Japan?
accept: What brings you to Japan?
words.ja: 無生物主語 bring（疑問文）
words.q: どうして日本に来たのですか。（What を主語に）
words.explain: Why did you come to Japan? より丁寧な言い方。What が主語なので did は不要、動詞は過去形
words.say: What brought you to Japan?

words.answer: It is easy for me to answer this question.
accept: It's easy for me to answer this question.
words.ja: It is 形容詞 for 人 to
words.q: 私にとってこの質問に答えるのは簡単です。（It で始めて）
words.explain: 形式主語 It＋形容詞＋for 人＋to do。answer は他動詞なので answer to は誤り
words.say: It is easy for me to answer this question.

words.answer: It is kind of you to say so.
accept: It's kind of you to say so.
It is nice of you to say so.
words.ja: It is 形容詞 of 人 to do
words.q: そう言ってくれるなんてあなたは親切ですね。（It で始めて）
words.explain: kind・nice・careless など人の性質を表す形容詞は of 人。for you にしない
words.say: It is kind of you to say so.

words.answer: I was too tired to walk any more.
accept: I was too tired to walk anymore.
words.q: 私は疲れすぎてもう歩けなかった。（too を使って）
words.explain: too＋形容詞＋to do＝〜すぎて…できない。否定語 not を足さない。「もう」は any more
words.say: I was too tired to walk any more.

words.answer: He is old enough to drive a car.
accept: He's old enough to drive a car.
He is old enough to drive.
words.q: 彼は車を運転できる年齢です。（enough を使って）
words.explain: enough は形容詞の後ろ（old enough）。enough old は誤り。名詞なら enough money の順
words.say: He is old enough to drive a car.

words.answer: He was so tired that he could not walk.
accept: He was so tired that he couldn't walk.
He was so tired he couldn't walk.
words.q: 彼はとても疲れていたので歩けなかった。（so … that を使って）
words.explain: so＋形容詞＋that＋S V。that 節には主語と助動詞が必要（too … to と違い not を入れる）
words.say: He was so tired that he could not walk.

words.answer: It was such a nice day that we went out.
accept: It was such a fine day that we went out.
It was such a good day that we went out.
It was such a nice day that we went outside.
words.q: とてもいい日だったので私たちは出かけた。（such を使って）
words.explain: such＋a＋形容詞＋名詞＋that。so なら so nice a day の語順。a such nice day は誤り
words.say: It was such a nice day that we went out.

words.answer: No matter how hard I try, I cannot win.
accept: No matter how hard I try, I can't win.
words.q: どんなに一生懸命やっても、私は勝てない。（No matter で始めて）
words.explain: No matter how＋副詞＋S V。hard を how の直後に置く。how I try hard は誤り
words.say: No matter how hard I try, I cannot win.

words.answer: Whatever happens, I will stay with you.
accept: Whatever happens, I'll stay with you.
No matter what happens, I will stay with you.
words.q: 何が起ころうとも、私はあなたのそばにいます。
words.explain: Whatever happens＝No matter what happens。譲歩節は現在形、主節は will
words.say: Whatever happens, I will stay with you.

words.answer: However busy you are, you should eat breakfast.
words.q: どんなに忙しくても、朝食は食べるべきです。（However で始めて）
words.explain: However＋形容詞＋S V＝No matter how。busy は However の直後。「しかし」の however と区別
words.say: However busy you are, you should eat breakfast.
accept: However busy you are, you should have breakfast.

words.answer: Wherever you go, I will follow you.
accept: Wherever you go, I'll follow you.
No matter where you go, I will follow you.
words.q: あなたがどこへ行こうとも、私はついていきます。
words.explain: Wherever＝No matter where。譲歩節は現在形 go（will go にしない）。follow は他動詞
words.say: Wherever you go, I will follow you.

words.answer: Young as he is, he is very wise.
accept: Young as he is, he's very wise.
words.ja: 形容詞 as S V（譲歩）
words.q: 彼は若いけれども、とても賢い。（as を使った倒置で）
words.explain: 形容詞＋as＋S V＝Though he is young。形容詞を文頭に出す形。As young as he is とも言う
words.say: Young as he is, he is very wise.
